v.t: Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near, but they turn away heedlessly
v.l: Aqtaraba Lilnnasi Hisabuhum Wa Hum Fi Ghaflatin Mu`riđuna

v.t: No fresh reminder comes to them from their Lord, but they listen to it playfully
v.l: Ma Ya'tihim Min Dhikrin Min Rabbihim Muhdathin 'Illa Astama`uhu Wa Hum Yal`abuna

v.t: Their hearts distracted, the wrongdoers confer secretly, “Is this anything but a mortal like you? Will you take to sorcery, with open-eyes?”
v.l: Lahiyatan Qulubuhum Wa 'Asarru An-Najwa Al-Ladhina Zalamu Hal Hadha 'Illa Basharun Mithlukum 'Afata'tuna As-Sihra Wa 'Antum Tubsiruna

v.t: He said, “My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth; and He is the Hearer, the Knower.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Ya`lamu Al-Qawla Fi As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Huwa As-Sami`u Al-`Alimu

v.t: And they said, “A jumble of dreams,” and, “He made it up,” and, “He is a poet,” “let him bring us a sign, like those sent to the ancients.”
v.l: Bal Qalu 'Ađghathu 'Ahlamin Bal Aftarahu Bal Huwa Sha`irun Falya'tina Bi'ayatin Kama 'Ursila Al-'Awwaluna

v.t: None of the towns We destroyed before them had believed. Will they, then, believe
v.l: Ma 'Amanat Qablahum Min Qaryatin 'Ahlaknaha 'Afahum Yu'uminuna

v.t: We did not send before you except men, whom We inspired. Ask the people of knowledge, if you do not know
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Qablaka 'Illa Rijalaan Nuhi 'Ilayhim Fas'alu 'Ahla Adh-Dhikri 'In Kuntum La Ta`lamuna

v.t: We did not make them mere bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal
v.l: Wa Ma Ja`alnahum Jasadaan La Ya'kuluna At-Ta`ama Wa Ma Kanu Khalidina

v.t: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, and We saved them together with whomever We willed, and We destroyed the extravagant
v.l: Thumma Sadaqnahumu Al-Wa`da Fa'anjaynahum Wa Man Nasha'u Wa 'Ahlakna Al-Musrifina

v.t: We have sent down to you a Book, containing your message. Do you not understand
v.l: Laqad 'Anzalna 'Ilaykum Kitabaan Fihi Dhikrukum 'Afala Ta`qiluna

v.t: How many a guilty town have We crushed, and established thereafter another people
v.l: Wa Kam Qasamna Min Qaryatin Kanat Zalimatan Wa 'Ansha'na Ba`daha Qawmaan 'Akharina

v.t: Then, when they sensed Our might, they started running away from it
v.l: Falamma 'Ahassu Ba'sana 'Idha Hum Minha Yarkuđuna

v.t: Do not run, but come back to your luxuries, and to your homes, that you may be questioned
v.l: La Tarkuđu Wa Arji`u 'Ila Ma 'Utriftum Fihi Wa Masakinikum La`allakum Tus'aluna

v.t: They said, “Woe to us; we were unfair.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Waylana 'Inna Kunna Zalimina

v.t: This continued to be their cry, until We made them silent ashes
v.l: Fama Zalat Tilka Da`wahum Hatta Ja`alnahum Hasidaan Khamidina

v.t: We did not create the sky and the earth and what is between them for amusement
v.l: Wa Ma Khalaqna As-Sama'a Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma La`ibina

v.t: If We wanted amusement, We could have found it within Us, were We to do so
v.l: Law 'Aradna 'An Nattakhidha Lahwan Lattakhadhnahu Min Ladunna 'In Kunna Fa`ilina

v.t: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, and it crushes it, so it vanishes. Woe unto you, for what you describe
v.l: Bal Naqdhifu Bil-Haqqi `Ala Al-Batili Fayadmaghuhu Fa'idha Huwa Zahiqun Wa Lakumu Al-Waylu Mimma Tasifuna

v.t: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. Those near Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they waver
v.l: Wa Lahu Man Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Man `Indahu La Yastakbiruna `An `Ibadatihi Wa La Yastahsiruna

v.t: They praise night and day, without ever tiring
v.l: Yusabbihuna Al-Layla Wa An-Nahara La Yafturuna

v.t: Or have they taken to themselves gods from the earth who resurrect
v.l: Am Attakhadhu 'Alihatan Mina Al-'Arđi Hum Yunshiruna

v.t: If there were in them gods other than God, they would have gone to ruin. So glory be to God, Lord of the Throne, beyond what they allege
v.l: Law Kana Fihima 'Alihatun 'Illa Allahu Lafasadata Fasubhana Allahi Rabbi Al-`Arshi `Amma Yasifuna

v.t: He will not be questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned
v.l: La Yus'alu `Amma Yaf`alu Wa Hum Yus'aluna

v.t: Or have they taken, besides Him, other gods? Say, “Bring your proof. This is a message for those with me, and a message of those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away
v.l: Am Attakhadhu Min Dunihi 'Alihatan Qul Hatu Burhanakum Hadha Dhikru Man Ma`iya Wa Dhikru Man Qabli Bal 'Aktharuhum La Ya`lamuna Al-Haqqa Fahum Mu`riđuna

v.t: We never sent a messenger before you without inspiring him that: “There is no god but I, so worship Me.”
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Min Qablika Min Rasul 'Iinilla Nuhi 'Ilayhi 'Annahu La 'Ilaha 'Illa 'Ana Fa`buduni

v.t: And they say, “The Most Merciful has taken to himself a son.” Be He glorified; they are but honored servants
v.l: Wa Qalu Attakhadha Ar-Rahmanu Waladaan Subhanahu Bal `Ibadun Mukramuna

v.t: They never speak before He has spoken, and they only act on His command
v.l: La Yasbiqunahu Bil-Qawli Wa Hum Bi'amrihi Ya`maluna

v.t: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them; and they do not intercede except for him whom He approves; and they tremble in awe of Him
v.l: Ya`lamu Ma Bayna 'Aydihim Wa Ma Khalfahum Wa La Yashfa`una 'Illa Limani Artađa Wa Hum Min Khashyatihi Mushfiquna

v.t: And whoever of them says, “I am a god besides Him,” We will reward him with Hell. Thus We reward the wrongdoers
v.l: Wa Man Yaqul Minhum 'Inni 'Ilahun Min Dunihi Fadhalika Najzihi Jahannama Kadhalika Najzi Az-Zalimina

v.t: Do the disbelievers not see that the heavens and the earth were one mass, and We tore them apart? And We made from water every living thing. Will they not believe
v.l: Awalam Yara Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'Anna As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Kanata Ratqaan Fafataqnahuma Wa Ja`alna Mina Al-Ma'i Kulla Shay'in Hayyin 'Afala Yu'uminuna

v.t: And We placed on earth stabilizers, lest it sways with them, and We placed therein signposts and passages, that they may be guided
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Fi Al-'Arđi Rawasiya 'An Tamida Bihim Wa Ja`alna Fiha Fijajaan Subulaan La`allahum Yahtaduna

v.t: And We made the sky a protected ceiling; yet they turn away from its wonders
v.l: Wa Ja`alna As-Sama'a Saqfaan Mahfuzaan Wa Hum `An 'Ayatiha Mu`riđuna

v.t: It is He who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in an orbit
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Khalaqa Al-Layla Wa An-Nahara Wa Ash-Shamsa Wa Al-Qamara Kullun Fi Falakin Yasbahuna

v.t: We did not grant immortality to any human being before you. Should you die, are they then the immortal
v.l: Wa Ma Ja`alna Libasharin Min Qablika Al-Khulda 'Afa'in Mitta Fahumu Al-Khaliduna

v.t: Every soul will taste death. We burden you with adversity and prosperity—a test. And to Us you will be returned
v.l: Kullu Nafsin Dha'iqatu Al-Mawti Wa Nablukum Bish-Sharri Wa Al-Khayri Fitnatan Wa 'Ilayna Turja`una

v.t: When those who disbelieve see you, they treat you only with ridicule: “Is this the one who mentions your gods?” And they reject the mention of the Merciful
v.l: Wa 'Idha Ra'aka Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'In Yattakhidhunaka 'Illa Huzuan 'Ahadha Al-Ladhi Yadhkuru 'Alihatakum Wa Hum Bidhikri Ar-Rahmani Hum Kafiruna

v.t: The human being was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not seek to rush Me
v.l: Khuliqa Al-'Insanu Min `Ajalin Sa'urikum 'Ayati Fala Tasta`jiluni

v.t: And they say, “When will this promise come true, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Mata Hadha Al-Wa`du 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: If those who disbelieve only knew, when they cannot keep the fire off their faces and off their backs, and they will not be helped
v.l: Law Ya`lamu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Hina La Yakuffuna `An Wujuhihimu An-Nara Wa La `An Zuhurihim Wa La Hum Yunsaruna

v.t: In fact, it will come upon them suddenly, and bewilder them. They will not be able to repel it, and they will not be reprieved
v.l: Bal Ta'tihim Baghtatan Fatabhatuhum Fala Yastati`una Raddaha Wa La Hum Yunzaruna

v.t: Messengers before you were also ridiculed, but those who jeered were surrounded by what they had ridiculed
v.l: Wa Laqadi Astuhzi'a Birusulin Min Qablika Fahaqa Bial-Ladhina Sakhiru Minhum Ma Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: Say, “Who guards you against the Merciful by night and by day?” But they turn away from the mention of their Lord
v.l: Qul Man Yakla'uukum Bil-Layli Wa An-Nahari Mina Ar-Rahmani Bal Hum `An Dhikri Rabbihim Mu`riđuna

v.t: Or do they have gods who can defend them against Us? They cannot help themselves, nor will they be protected from Us
v.l: Am Lahum 'Alihatun Tamna`uhum Min Dunina La Yastati`una Nasra 'Anfusihim Wa La Hum Minna Yushabuna

v.t: We have given these enjoyments, and their ancestors, until time grew long upon them. Do they not see how We gradually reduce the land from its extremities? Are they then the victors
v.l: Bal Matta`na Ha'uula' Wa 'Aba'ahum Hatta Tala `Alayhimu Al-`Umuru 'Afala Yarawna 'Anna Na'ti Al-'Arđa Nanqusuha Min 'Atrafiha 'Afahumu Al-Ghalibuna

v.t: Say, “I am warning you through inspiration.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are being warned
v.l: Qul 'Innama 'Undhirukum Bil-Wahyi Wa La Yasma`u As-Summu Ad-Du`a'a 'Idha Ma Yundharuna

v.t: And when a breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they say, “Woe to us, we were truly wicked.”
v.l: Wa La'in Massat/hum Nafhatun Min `Adhabi Rabbika Layaqulunna Ya Waylana 'Inna Kunna Zalimina

v.t: We will set up the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so that no soul will suffer the least injustice. And even if it be the weight of a mustard-seed, We will bring it up. Sufficient are We as Reckoners
v.l: Wa Nađa`u Al-Mawazina Al-Qista Liyawmi Al-Qiyamati Fala Tuzlamu Nafsun Shay'aan Wa 'In Kana Mithqala Habbatin Min Khardalin 'Atayna Biha Wa Kafa Bina Hasibina

v.t: We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, and illumination, and a reminder for the righteous
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Wa Haruna Al-Furqana Wa Điya'an Wa Dhikraan Lilmuttaqina

v.t: Those who fear their Lord in private, and are apprehensive of the Hour
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yakhshawna Rabbahum Bil-Ghaybi Wa Hum Mina As-Sa`ati Mushfiquna

v.t: This too is a blessed message that We revealed. Are you going to deny it
v.l: Wa Hadha Dhikrun Mubarakun 'Anzalnahu 'Afa'antum Lahu Munkiruna

v.t: We gave Abraham his integrity formerly, and We knew him well
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna 'Ibrahima Rushdahu Min Qablu Wa Kunna Bihi `Alimina

v.t: When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are devoted?”
v.l: Idh Qala Li'abihi Wa Qawmihi Ma Hadhihi At-Tamathilu Allati 'Antum Laha `Akifuna

v.t: They said, “We found our parents worshiping them.”
v.l: Qalu Wajadna 'Aba'ana Laha `Abidina

v.t: He said, “You and your parents are in evident error.”
v.l: Qala Laqad Kuntum 'Antum Wa 'Aba'uukum Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: They said, “Are you telling us the truth, or are you just playing?”
v.l: Qalu 'Aji'tana Bil-Haqqi 'Am 'Anta Mina Al-La`ibina

v.t: He said, “Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the One who created them, and I bear witness to that
v.l: Qala Bal Rabbukum Rabbu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Al-Ladhi Fatarahunna Wa 'Ana `Ala Dhalikum Mina Ash-Shahidina

v.t: “By God, I will have a plan for your statues after you have gone away.”
v.l: Wa Talllahi La'akidanna 'Asnamakum Ba`da 'An Tuwallu Mudbirina

v.t: So he reduced them into pieces, except for their biggest, that they may return to it
v.l: Faja`alahum Judhadhaan 'Illa Kabiraan Lahum La`allahum 'Ilayhi Yarji`una

v.t: They said, “Who did this to our gods? He is certainly one of the wrongdoers.”
v.l: Qalu Man Fa`ala Hadha Bi'alihatina 'Innahu Lamina Az-Zalimina

v.t: They said, “We heard a youth mentioning them. He is called Abraham.”
v.l: Qalu Sami`na Fataan Yadhkuruhum Yuqalu Lahu 'Ibrahimu

v.t: They said, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness.”
v.l: Qalu Fa'tu Bihi `Ala 'A`yuni An-Nasi La`allahum Yash/haduna

v.t: They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”
v.l: Qalu 'A'anta Fa`alta Hadha Bi'alihatina Ya 'Ibrahimu

v.t: He said, “But it was this biggest of them that did it. Ask them, if they can speak.”
v.l: Qala Bal Fa`alahu Kabiruhum Hadha Fas'aluhum 'In Kanu Yantiquna

v.t: Then they turned to one another, and said, “You yourselves are the wrongdoers.”
v.l: Faraja`u 'Ila 'Anfusihim Faqalu 'Innakum 'Antumu Az-Zalimuna

v.t: But they reverted to their old ideas: “You certainly know that these do not speak.”
v.l: Thumma Nukisu `Ala Ru'usihim Laqad `Alimta Ma Ha'uula' Yantiquna

v.t: He said, “Do you worship, instead of God, what can neither benefit you in anything, nor harm you
v.l: Qala 'Afata`buduna Min Duni Allahi Ma La Yanfa`ukum Shay'aan Wa La Yađurrukum

v.t: Fie on you, and on what you worship instead of God. Do you not understand?”
v.l: Uffin Lakum Wa Lima Ta`buduna Min Duni Allahi 'Afala Ta`qiluna

v.t: They said, “Burn him and support your gods, if you are going to act.”
v.l: Qalu Harriquhu Wa Ansuru 'Alihatakum 'In Kuntum Fa`ilina

v.t: We said, “O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham.”
v.l: Qulna Ya Naru Kuni Bardaan Wa Salamaan `Ala 'Ibrahima

v.t: They planned to harm him, but We made them the worst losers
v.l: Wa 'Aradu Bihi Kaydaan Faja`alnahumu Al-'Akhsarina

v.t: And We delivered him, and Lot, to the land that We blessed for all people
v.l: Wa Najjaynahu Wa Lutaan 'Ila Al-'Arđi Allati Barakna Fiha Lil`alamina

v.t: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift; and each We made righteous
v.l: Wa Wahabna Lahu 'Ishaqa Wa Ya`quba Nafilatan Wa Kullaan Ja`alna Salihina

v.t: And We made them leaders, guiding by Our command; and We inspired them to do good works, and to observe the prayer, and to give out charity. They were devoted servants to Us
v.l: Wa Ja`alnahum 'A'immatan Yahduna Bi'amrina Wa 'Awhayna 'Ilayhim Fi`la Al-Khayrati Wa 'Iqama As-Salaati Wa 'Ita'a Az-Zakaati Wa Kanu Lana `Abidina

v.t: And Lot—We gave him judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that practiced the abominations. They were wicked and perverted people
v.l: Wa Lutaan 'Ataynahu Hukmaan Wa `Ilmaan Wa Najjaynahu Mina Al-Qaryati Allati Kanat Ta`malu Al-Khaba'itha 'Innahum Kanu Qawma Saw'in Fasiqina

v.t: And We admitted him into Our mercy; for He was one of the righteous
v.l: Wa 'Adkhalnahu Fi Rahmatina 'Innahu Mina As-Salihina

v.t: And Noah, when he called before. So We answered him, and delivered him and his family from the great disaster
v.l: Wa Nuhaan 'Idh Nada Min Qablu Fastajabna Lahu Fanajjaynahu Wa 'Ahlahu Mina Al-Karbi Al-`Azimi

v.t: And We supported him against the people who rejected Our signs. They were an evil people, so We drowned them all
v.l: Wa Nasarnahu Mina Al-Qawmi Al-Ladhina Kadhabu Bi'ayatina 'Innahum Kanu Qawma Saw'in Fa'aghraqnahum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the case of the field, when some people’s sheep wandered therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment
v.l: Wa Dawuda Wa Sulaymana 'Idh Yahkumani Fi Al-Harthi 'Idh Nafashat Fihi Ghanamu Al-Qawmi Wa Kunna Lihukmihim Shahidina

v.t: And so We made Solomon understand it, and to each We gave wisdom and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains along with David to sing Our praises, and the birds as well—surely We did
v.l: Fafahhamnaha Sulaymana Wa Kullaan 'Atayna Hukmaan Wa `Ilmaan Wa Sakhkharna Ma`a Dawuda Al-Jibala Yusabbihna Wa At-Tayra Wa Kunna Fa`ilina
w: And We gave understanding of it

v.t: And We taught him the making of shields for you, to protect you from your violence. Are you, then, appreciative
v.l: Wa `Allamnahu San`ata Labusin Lakum Lituhsinakum Min Ba'sikum Fahal 'Antum Shakiruna

v.t: And to Solomon the stormy wind, blowing at His command towards the land that We have blessed. We are aware of everything
v.l: Wa Lisulaymana Ar-Riha `Asifatan Tajri Bi'amrihi 'Ila Al-'Arđi Allati Barakna Fiha Wa Kunna Bikulli Shay'in `Alimina

v.t: And of the devils were some that dived for him, and performed other, lesser tasks. But We kept them restrained
v.l: Wa Mina Ash-Shayatini Man Yaghusuna Lahu Wa Ya`maluna `Amalaan Duna Dhalika Wa Kunna Lahum Hafizina

v.t: And Job, when he cried out to his Lord: “Great harm has afflicted me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
v.l: Wa 'Ayyuba 'Idh Nada Rabbahu 'Anni Massani Ađ-Đurru Wa 'Anta 'Arhamu Ar-Rahimina

v.t: So We answered him, lifted his suffering, and restored his family to him, and their like with them—a mercy from Us, and a reminder for the worshipers
v.l: Fastajabna Lahu Fakashafna Ma Bihi Min Đurrin Wa 'Ataynahu 'Ahlahu Wa Mithlahum Ma`ahum Rahmatan Min `Indina Wa Dhikra Lil`abidina

v.t: And Ishmael, and Enoch, and Ezekiel; each was one of the steadfast
v.l: Wa 'Isma`ila Wa 'Idrisa Wa Dha Al-Kifli Kullun Mina As-Sabirina

v.t: And We admitted them into Our mercy. They were among the righteous
v.l: Wa 'Adkhalnahum Fi Rahmatina 'Innahum Mina As-Salihina

v.t: And Jonah, when he stormed out in fury, thinking We had no power over him. But then He cried out in the darkness, “There is no god but You! Glory to You! I was one of the wrongdoers!”
v.l: Wa Dha An-Nuni 'Idh Dhahaba Mughađibaan Fazanna 'An Lan Naqdira `Alayhi Fanada Fi Az-Zulumati 'An La 'Ilaha 'Illa 'Anta Subhanaka 'Inni Kuntu Mina Az-Zalimina

v.t: So We answered him, and saved him from the affliction. Thus We save the faithful
v.l: Fastajabna Lahu Wa Najjaynahu Mina Al-Ghammi Wa Kadhalika Nunji Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: And Zechariah, when he called out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me alone, even though you are the Best of heirs.”
v.l: Wa Zakariya 'Idh Nada Rabbahu Rabbi La Tadharni Fardaan Wa 'Anta Khayru Al-Warithina

v.t: So We answered him, and gave him John. And We cured his wife for him. They used to vie in doing righteous deeds, and used to call on Us in love and awe, and they used to humble themselves to Us
v.l: Fastajabna Lahu Wa Wahabna Lahu Yahya Wa 'Aslahna Lahu Zawjahu 'Innahum Kanu Yusari`una Fi Al-Khayrati Wa Yad`unana Raghabaan Wa Rahabaan Wa Kanu Lana Khashi`ina

v.t: And she who guarded her virginity. We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a sign to the world
v.l: Wa A-Ati 'Ahsanat Farjaha Fanafakhna Fiha Min Ruhina Wa Ja`alnaha Wa Abnaha 'Ayatan Lil`alamina

v.t: This community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord, so worship Me
v.l: Inna Hadhihi 'Ummatukum 'Ummatan Wahidatan Wa 'Ana Rabbukum Fa`buduni

v.t: But they splintered themselves into factions. They will all return to Us
v.l: Wa Taqatta`u 'Amrahum Baynahum Kullun 'Ilayna Raji`una

v.t: Whoever does righteous deeds, and is a believer, his effort will not be denied. We are writing it down for him
v.l: Faman Ya`mal Mina As-Salihati Wa Huwa Mu'uminun Fala Kufrana Lisa`yihi Wa 'Inna Lahu Katibuna

v.t: There is a ban on the town that We had destroyed—that they will not return
v.l: Wa Haramun `Ala Qaryatin 'Ahlaknaha 'Annahum La Yarji`una

v.t: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they swarm down from every mound
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Futihat Ya'juju Wa Ma'juju Wa Hum Min Kulli Hadabin Yansiluna

v.t: The promise of truth has drawn near. The eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror: “Woe to us. We were oblivious to this. In fact, we were wrongdoers.”
v.l: Waqtaraba Al-Wa`du Al-Haqqu Fa'idha Hiya Shakhisatun 'Absaru Al-Ladhina Kafaru Ya Waylana Qad Kunna Fi Ghaflatin Min Hadha Bal Kunna Zalimina

v.t: You and what you worship besides God are fuel for Hell. You will descend into it
v.l: Innakum Wa Ma Ta`buduna Min Duni Allahi Hasabu Jahannama 'Antum Laha Wa Ariduna

v.t: Had these been gods, they would not have descended into it. All will abide in it
v.l: Law Kana Ha'uula' 'Alihatan Ma Waraduha Wa Kullun Fiha Khaliduna

v.t: In it they will wail. In it they will not hear
v.l: Lahum Fiha Zafirun Wa Hum Fiha La Yasma`una

v.t: As for those who deserved goodness from Us—these will be kept away from it
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Sabaqat Lahum Minna Al-Husna 'Ula'ika `Anha Mub`aduna

v.t: They will not hear its hissing, and they will forever abide in what their hearts desire
v.l: La Yasma`una Hasisaha Wa Hum Fi Ma Ashtahat 'Anfusuhum Khaliduna

v.t: The Supreme Fear will not worry them, and the angels will receive them: “This is your Day which you were promised.”
v.l: La Yahzunuhumu Al-Faza`u Al-'Akbaru Wa Tatalaqqahumu Al-Mala'ikatu Hadha Yawmukumu Al-Ladhi Kuntum Tu`aduna

v.t: On the Day when We fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as We began the first creation, We will repeat it—a promise binding on Us. We will act
v.l: Yawma Natwi As-Sama'a Katayyi As-Sijilli Lilkutubi Kama Bada'na 'Awwala Khalqin Nu`iduhu Wa`daan `Alayna 'Inna Kunna Fa`ilina

v.t: We have written in the Psalms, after the Reminder, that the earth will be inherited by My righteous servants
v.l: Wa Laqad Katabna Fi Az-Zaburi Min Ba`di Adh-Dhikri 'Anna Al-'Arđa Yarithuha `Ibadiya As-Salihuna

v.t: Indeed, in this is a message for people who worship
v.l: Inna Fi Hadha Labalaghaan Liqawmin `Abidina

v.t: We did not send you except as mercy to mankind
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalnaka 'Illa Rahmatan Lil`alamina

v.t: Say, “It is revealed to me that your God is One God. Are you going to submit?”
v.l: Qul 'Innama Yuha 'Ilayya 'Annama 'Ilahukum 'Ilahun Wahidun Fahal 'Antum Muslimuna

v.t: But if they turn away, say, “I have informed you sufficiently. Although I do not know whether what you are promised is near or far.”
v.l: Fa'in Tawallaw Faqul 'Adhantukum `Ala Sawa'in Wa 'In 'Adri 'Aqaribun 'Am Ba`idun Ma Tu`aduna

v.t: He knows what is said openly, and He knows what you conceal
v.l: Innahu Ya`lamu Al-Jahra Mina Al-Qawli Wa Ya`lamu Ma Taktumuna

v.t: “And I do not know whether it is perhaps a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.”
v.l: Wa 'In 'Adri La`allahu Fitnatun Lakum Wa Mata`un 'Ila Hinin

v.t: He said, “My Lord, judge with justice.” And, “Our Lord is the Gracious, Whose help is sought against what you allege.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Ahkum Bil-Haqqi Wa Rabbuna Ar-Rahmanu Al-Musta`anu `Ala Ma Tasifuna
w: the One Whose help is sought
